actions.name: draft_tiles
actions.description: Choose one source and one color present at that source.

source_index.description: Factory index is required for a factory; null for the center. Omission means null.

actions.name: place_tiles
actions.description: Choose a pattern line or the floor for the drafted tiles.

row.description: Pattern-line index 0..4 has capacity 1..5 and is required for a pattern line. Null for the floor; omission means null.
